Hi Evan — thanks for sending the bank letter and W-9. A few clarifying items from AP before we can change remit instructions in our ERP: 

1) We require one of the following for ACH updates:
   - a bank letter on official bank letterhead confirming account ownership and routing (we have that attached), AND an ACH Authorization form signed by an authorized signer on Boreal letterhead; OR
   - a micro-deposit verification performed by our payment vendor (we can initiate if you prefer).
2) Please confirm the legal company name as it appears on invoices (we have Boreal Supply Co. on file — confirm no legal entity change).
3) Confirm EIN for tax records (we have EIN ending in -4823 on record; please confirm full EIN if it changed).

If you can send the signed ACH form and a scanned voided check, AP can typically complete verification within 2–3 business days once documents are validated. If you prefer micro-deposits, that route takes ~3–5 business days depending on bank.

Best,
